label: Ascent at esse restricted to actual identity bearers
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. In the same q3 profile, any actual c whose represented esse equals its represented essence is more in esse than every distinct actual x whose esse it causes. The actuality and identity restrictions weaken cffad050; no claim about an arbitrary received intermediate cause is included. No source existence, causal coverage, common nature, present conservation, naming or actual application follows from the restriction itself. Direct primitive warrant and the explicit reception-based support option are both retained.
